# ui::TextMetrics

Header: `winui/render/Text.hpp`.

What a [TextMeasurer](text-measurer.md) reports for a run of text: its extent, where its first baseline sits and how many lines it took. Converts to a [Size](../core/size.md) (the extent), so code that only needs the box reads [`.width`](#width) and [`.height`](#height) or assigns it to a [Size](../core/size.md).

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::TextStyle   style{.font_size = 14.0f};
const ui::TextMetrics metrics = measurer.measure("Hello", style);
const ui::Size        box     = metrics; // width x height
const float           ascent  = metrics.baseline;
```

## width

```cpp
float width = 0.0f
```

The widest line's width, in DIPs.

## height

```cpp
float height = 0.0f
```

The height of all lines together, in DIPs.

## baseline

```cpp
float baseline = 0.0f
```

From the top of the box to the first line's baseline, in DIPs.

## line_count

```cpp
int line_count = 1
```

How many lines the text took; 1 for a single line, empty text included.

## size

```cpp
Size size() const
```

The extent, width x height.
